admission.justification: Spans options/status/result reads and message delivery: reads never collect or delete folders, and delivery proceeds with collection failure reported separately — the non-mutating-read half of FAM-2BRZW7.

applicability: Every options, status or result read and every role-message delivery.
conditions: The read path projects receipt state without touching the filesystem.
A delivery whose report collection fails still proceeds, with the failure returned separately.
exclusions: Collection or deletion as a side effect of a read.
statement: Options/status/result reads do not collect or delete report folders. Delivery of a role message proceeds even if its report collection fails, with the collection failure returned separately.
